software.license: MIT AND Apache-2.0 AND ISC AND LGPL-3.0-or-later AND X11

modifications: Product assets are unchanged. The static server and runtime apply the serving and navigation policies described in configuration.
configuration: Serve package/dist/editor from the npm archive at / and /index.html with the default extensions. Only storagePrompt=true or storagePrompt=false queries are accepted. Browser storage holds drawings and preferences. Static resources use an allowlist and CSP; external requests, frames and filesystem picker APIs are unavailable.

notes.source_availability: The archive contains package/src, package/packages/svgcanvas and source maps with sourcesContent of every bundled module.
notes.component_licenses: LICENSES and NOTICE explain the npm license expression and the licenses of bundled modules.
